sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana scheme was launched by the Department of Skill, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation to enhance candidates' employability through practical training with entrepreneurs with a budget of ₹5,500 crore.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Skills & Employment; Sector: Training and Skill Up-gradation

**Detailed Description:** The Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana scheme was launched by the Department of Skill, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation to enhance candidates' employability through practical training with entrepreneurs. The scheme budget of ₹5,500 crore, and the training programs for approximately 10 lakh candidates per year.  ***Training Duration:*** Job Training will be for 6 months.

**Benefits / Assistance:** **Stipend:** 12th Pass - 6,000/- ITI / Diploma - 8,000/- Degree / Post Graduation - 10,000/-  **Note:** Stipends are transferred directly to trainees' bank accounts linked with Aadhaar.

**Application Process:** ***Registration Process for Candidate:*** - Go to the official [CMYKPY website](https://cmykpy.mahaswayam.gov.in/Index.aspx) for job seeker registration and click on “**Intern Login**”.- Use your Aadhaar number as the username for your account. - Fill in your full name, date of birth, gender, email, and mobile number. - Create a secure password and confirm it. - After completing all required fields, submit the registration form to finish the process.  ***Log In Process:*** - Fill Your Aadhar Number as a User Name and Password. - Complete your profile details, and fill in the personal, address, qualification, and bank details. - Upload the photo, qualification document, birth certificate, etc. - Click on “Submit” and apply for the job.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Department
**Tags:** Vocational Training, Specially-Abled Person, Student, Stipend
